stem.en: How is the quark-gluon plasma's existence actually established, given it cannot be directly observed by any detector?
stem.et: Kuidas kvark-gluuonplasma olemasolu tegelikult tuvastatakse, arvestades, et seda ei saa ükski detektor otse vaadelda?

label.en: By inferring it indirectly from characteristic patterns in the final observed particles, such as jet suppression, best explained by a brief intermediate plasma phase.
label.et: Kaudselt järeldades seda iseloomulikest mustritest lõplikes vaadeldud osakestes, näiteks joa allasurumisest, mida seletab kõige paremini lühike vahepealne plasmafaas.

label.en: By directly smashing individual quarks out of individual protons one at a time and observing each quark's track separately.
label.et: Otse purustades üksikuid kvarke üksikutest prootonitest ükshaaval ja vaadeldes iga kvargi jälge eraldi.

label.en: By directly imaging the plasma itself with a detector, the same way an ordinary particle track is directly observed.
label.et: Kujutades otse plasmat ennast detektoriga, samamoodi nagu tavalist osakese jälge otse vaadeldakse.

label.en: By observing that it behaves as a weakly interacting gas of nearly free quarks and gluons, exactly matching its name.
label.et: Vaadeldes, et see käitub nõrgalt interakteeruva peaaegu vabade kvarkide ja gluuonite gaasina, täpselt vastavuses selle nimega.
